rationale: Same unit and obligation, one further bounded observation: the harness now also delivers the recoverer's Commit broadcast to the already-committed replica and to a third replica that never saw the instance, and the plan adds a property that all three must hold the same committed command. This tests whether the disagreement produced by the non-adopting resolution survives propagation rather than being repaired by the commit broadcast. The local construction run shows replica 0 NOOP, replica 1 PUT and replica 2 NOOP, i.e. two different committed commands for one instance across the cluster; the formal observation is left to the trusted runner and a fresh correspondence review.
